description: Enphase package QA ownership for Figma/email generation.
instructions: Use active Enphase persona rules and approved Enphase references as the only persona-pattern sources.

Preserve source boundaries: do not copy sample campaign copy, claims, prices, disclaimers, CTA labels, phone numbers, personalization strings, URLs, tracking parameters, hosted image URLs, or complete campaign blocks unless present in Figma primary reference/metadata or explicitly requested.

Apply shared email constraints: table-first HTML, role="presentation" on layout tables, td align/valign attributes, no colspan, no unsupported tags/CSS, no image height attributes or inline image height CSS, no content td heights except CTA button and empty spacer cells, no paragraph-only td width, no span font-family, and span font-size/line-height only for intentional inline differences.

Apply Enphase SFMC requirements: every anchor includes conversion, data-linkto, href, title, and alias; web links use target="_blank"; static web URLs include exactly one utm_campaign=%%=v(@utm_campaign)=%% (href="#" when no destination URL exists); mailto/sms links use conversion="false" and data-linkto="other"; phone numbers require @CallCTA declared via CloudPagesURL before HTML and phone anchors use RedirectTo(@CallCTA) with conversion="true" and data-linkto="https://".

Verify Enphase header/footer selection: the header and footer ContentBlockbyID values and their paired comment names must match the detected country's pair from references/Header and Footer Blocks.md, with the US fallback (Header_Dark_Version1_EN 196561 + NA_Footer_Section 171497) used when no matching block exists.
Do not apply Standard dark-mode QA unless Enphase package assets explicitly add it.
After editing, do one concise output-only source/persona review and let the automated completion gate report mechanical blockers.
